172:t_103:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$! Even without the $$赤い彗星$$, I'll bear the karma of the $$スペースノイド$$s!」

172:t_104:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're persistent, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! Are you going to trample through someone else's heart again?!」

172:t_104:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't intend to deal with someone so stubborn forever, either!」

172:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'm telling you that way of speaking is rude! Know your place, $$カミーユ$$!」

172:t_105:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You must be delighted, $$アムロ・レイ$$! You managed to separate $$シャア$$ from $$ジオン$$!」

172:t_105:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$ decided that himself. I had nothing to do with it.」

172:t_105:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Nonsense! Your very existence made him waver!」

172:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You'll pay for that, $$アムロ$$! I'll kill you!」

172:t_105:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're like a girl obsessed with purity, $$ハマーン$$! Some Iron Lady you are!」

172:t_106:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「How pathetic, boy! Have you parted ways with the friend you trusted?!」

172:t_106:1.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't pity me! I haven't given in to despair!」

172:t_106:2.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm not like you! I'll keep believing in someone I trusted to the very end, and do all I can to reach them with words!」

172:t_106:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're just what I'd expect of $$カミーユ・ビダン$$'s friend! You know nothing of manners!」

172:t_106:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You'll pay for the words you've spat out!」

172:t_106:5.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't lose to a woman who gets hysterical when someone hits the mark!」

172:t_107:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Are you dragging $$プラント$$ into war again?!」

172:t_107:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They chose it. We're merely cooperating.」

172:t_107:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「You've... twisted your feelings and are using your power the wrong way...!」

172:t_107:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It's the world that's twisted and wrong! I'm fighting to change it, too!」

172:t_107:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Then I'll stop you with the wishes $$ラクス$$ entrusted to me and the power I possess!」

172:t_108:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「You're on the same level as this little girl whenever the Colonel is involved!」

172:t_108:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「He betrayed $$ネオ・ジオン$$ despite being its leader...! He must pay for that!」

172:t_108:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's not it, $$ハマーン$$! The Colonel is fighting for something bigger!」

172:t_108:5.en:
$$クェス$$
「You should understand that! Be more honest with yourself and trust what you feel!」

172:t_109:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「We meet again, Mr. $$リアクター$$.」

172:t_109:1.en:
$n
「That's just what I wanted. I owe you for last time.」

172:t_109:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Don't say such violent things. What do you say? Why not accept my boss's offer from last time?」

172:t_109:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Your answer must be 'aye' or 'yes.'」

172:t_109:4.en:
$n
「Then I'll turn you all to ash!」

172:t_109:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You played that well! You got me there!」

172:t_110:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's been a while, $$セツコ$$. I'm glad to see you're well.」

172:t_110:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... Of course. That's a perfectly natural reaction.」

172:t_110:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$...! I'll stop you... and $$バルビエル$$ with my own hands!」

172:t_110:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I won't let you spread your hatred through this world!」

172:t_110:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(She's sharp, as expected... It's no wonder the boss is wary of her...)

kept_omissions: 172:t_110:1: Setsuko cannot finish her angry reproach to Sardias; its unstated accusation is retained.
uncertain: 172:t_109:4: Meaning uncertainty: the threat to reduce the enemy to ashes is preserved, but the Japanese hai/ash wordplay on the preceding required affirmative answer cannot be reproduced by aye/yes; the English loses the homophonic pun.
